prompt: The viewer navigates through a snowy night along the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal, moving steadily forward as the camera captures the path ahead. The first-person perspective reveals the trail winding through a dense forest, with snowflakes continuously falling from the dark sky, creating a serene yet isolated atmosphere. The camera pans slightly to the left, revealing twisted tree branches and rugged terrain partially covered in snow, emphasizing the natural and untouched environment. As the journey continues, the camera angle shifts subtly, focusing on the ground where footprints mark the path, indicating prior passage. The surrounding trees loom large, their silhouettes stark against the dimly lit backdrop, while the faint glow of ambient light casts soft shadows, enhancing the depth and texture of the scene. The trail ascends gently, and the camera tilts upward, capturing the expansive night sky dotted with falling snow, adding a sense of vastness and tranquility. The environment remains empty, devoid of any human presence, reinforcing the solitude of the nocturnal trek. The consistent forward motion of the camera maintains a steady pace, immersing the viewer in the quiet, snow-laden landscape of the Mardi Himal Trail.
